episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Yeon Tae-seo heads to the countryside with his younger brother to stay with their grandparents. There, he meets Mo Eun-a and the two form a special bond.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Tae-seo and Eun-a's relationship continues to blossom, progressing from romance to intimacy. But adulthood soon separates them, testing their connection.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: From school to relationships and work, Tae-seo struggles to juggle his responsibilities. Meanwhile, Eun-a's career begins to reshape her life.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Ten years later, Tae-seo and Eun-a live completely different lives. One day, they cross paths again by chance — stirring old feelings.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: After running into Eun-a again, Tae-seo looks after her out of concern — but unresolved feelings keep things awkward between them.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Eun-a and Tae-seo slowly settle back into their rekindled rhythm. Meanwhile, they both navigate challenging personal and family issues.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Despite help from Bae Seong-chan, Eun-a struggles to find her place in the world. Tae-seo deals with unease as he confronts his family's health issues.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Eun-a makes a decision that forces her and Tae-seo apart again. Soon after, a major misunderstanding leaves him heartbroken and betrayed.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Before long, Tae-seo's life returns to how it was before he reunited with Eun-a. But the question of why they broke up still lingers in his mind.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Eun-a decides where she will go, while Tae-seo decides how to say goodbye. Will their love endure -- even until the very last moment?
